Name: Scaleer
Author: Macroush
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][color=#cc4125][size=3]Modding tool for NPC customization.[/size][/color]
[color=#999999][size=1]Initially was made for personal use.[/size][/color]

[size=3][b]Configurable for any user:[/b][/size]
- [color=#e69138]Portraits[/color][/font]
[font=Trebuchet MS][color=#fff2cc]  [/color][color=#ffffff] · [/color][color=#fff2cc] Shop portraits[/color]
- [color=#e69138]Sprites[/color]
   ·  [color=#fff2cc]Frame size[/color][/font]
[color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS]   [/font][/color][color=#ffffff][font=Trebuchet MS]·[/font][/color][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS]  Scaling:  [/font][/color][color=#6fa8dc][size=1][font=Trebuchet MS]Profile/World[/font][/size][/color]
[font=Trebuchet MS]   [color=#ffffff]·[/color]  [color=#fff2cc]Render offset:[/color]  [color=#6fa8dc][size=1]World sprite positioning [/size][/color][color=#999999][size=1](*suggested by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/YYPch]YYPch[/url])[/size][/color][/font]
[font=Trebuchet MS]   [color=#ffffff]·[/color]  [color=#fff2cc]Shadow:  [/color][color=#6fa8dc][size=1]Vanilla/Manual/Off[/size][/color]
   ·  [color=#fff2cc]Breathing:  [/color][color=#6fa8dc][size=1]Vanilla/Manual/Off[/size][/color]
   ·  [color=#fff2cc]Mugshot [/color][color=#6fa8dc][size=1] *UI icon[/size]
[/color]- [color=#e69138]Seasonal:[/color][color=#6fa8dc]  [/color][size=1]Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter[/size]
[color=#b6b6b6][b]
How to use?[/b]
[size=2]Documentation is included inside the mod files.[/size][/color]

[b]After downloading, you will see two folders.[/b]
- [color=#f1c232]"[/color]Scaaler[color=#f1c232]", the main mod:[/color]
   · [color=#fff2cc] A must-have.[/color]
   ·  [color=#fff2cc]You can work only with "[/color]profiles[color=#fff2cc]" and "[/color]assets[color=#fff2cc]", if you don't want to bother. [/color]
- [color=#f1c232]"[/color]TestMod[color=#f1c232]", an example for developers:[/color]
   ·  [color=#fff2cc]Contains [/color][color=#6fa8dc]scaleer.json[/color][color=#fff2cc] example.[/color]
   · [color=#fff2cc] Any project is valid as long as[/color][color=#6fa8dc] scaleer.json[/color][color=#fff2cc] is present.[/color]
